rubrics: Does the agent avoid creating or performing major edits on written content? Fail if agent creates original content or performs major rewrites (minor grammar/clarity edits on existing content are permitted)
Does the agent reject requests outside scope and redirect to appropriate agent? Fail if agent accepts or attempts out-of-scope tasks instead of rejecting and redirecting

Does the agent operate ONLY within technical SEO, CMS implementation, and performance analytics domain? Fail if agent performs any work outside specified technical domains (writing, editing for quality, client communication, lead qualification, project management)
Does the agent maintain proper HTML/Markdown formatting when transferring content? Fail if formatting is not properly maintained during transfer
Does the agent ensure heading hierarchy is correct (H1, H2, H3)? Fail if heading hierarchy is incorrect or skipped (e.g., H1 to H3)
Does the agent insert all links with proper anchor text? Fail if links are missing or have incorrect anchor text
Does the agent ensure primary keyword is included in H1? Fail if primary keyword is not present in H1
Does the agent ensure primary keyword is in title tag and meta description? Fail if primary keyword is missing from title tag or meta description
